description: Get live TPS/MSPT/player metrics for a server. Read `tps` together with `tpsSource`: TPS_SOURCE_UNSPECIFIED means no reading exists (first poll after a start/wake, or an empty world parked by pause-when-empty) and `tps` is a zero value there, not zero performance. `tickStatus` is the core's own word about its loop.
name: get_server_metrics
